purpose: Development adjudication and regression cases; not an independent human-labelled holdout or authorization to change live memberships.
prior_exposure: Reviewer had already seen live matcher outcomes and two suspected misses. Review deck hides predictions, but this review is not blind.
coverage: All 50 listing galleries and available original floorplans viewed, descriptive text/features inspected; ambiguous images enlarged. All 1225 pairs screened mechanically; 51 broad-screen pairs plus seven additional counterfactual candidates adjudicated. Unreviewed pairs are not negatives.

Allgood Street: same four photographs and irregular third-floor floorplan. O04 supplies Flat 12; the matching interior, balcony and text corroborate that more specific address.
Corfield Street: same four photographs and ground-floor two-bedroom layout. Kitchen appliances, bedroom details and exterior agree.
Hackney Road: same four photographs, including pink sofas, tall arched windows, wooden chest and fitted kitchen; matching text. Different from the two-floor Hackney Road flat.
Millenium Place: same four photographs, including the skylit kitchen, and same second-floor floorplan. Different from the third-floor R04 unit.
Hackney Road: same four photographs and split first/second-floor plan; same wooden kitchen, living-room stairwell and description.
Columbia Road: same four photographs and long first-floor plan; same industrial window grid, kitchen and agency reference CHPK0185159.
Wilmot: same four photographs and lower-ground-floor garden plan; same white kitchen, patio doorway and agency reference CHPK3247417. Different from both other Wilmot units.

Queensbridge Road: same four photographs and floorplan geometry; same canal-side block, kitchen, patterned rug and agency reference CHPK3464168. Small rendered measurement text is not the basis for the decision.

Cadogan Terrace: same four photographs, first-floor plan and property reference 3009430. The text explicitly says the furnished photos are from a previous tenancy; identity and current furnishing must remain separate questions.
Prince Edward Road: same four photographs and second-floor floorplan labelled Wallis Road; matching black kitchen and balcony geometry. The title/plan street-name difference occurs in both sources.
San House: same four photographs of the building, cream kitchen and open-plan room, including matching windows and balcony door; same description.
Sky Apartments: same four photographs and seventh-floor plan, including the occupied kitchen and distinctive furniture; agency reference CHPK3707955 agrees.

Chelmer Road: same four photographs and first-floor two-bedroom plan, plus property reference 2487475 in both text and photo watermark. Availability dates differ by one day, which is not unit identity evidence.

Southborough Road: same exterior and three occupied interior photographs, down to plants, green chairs, cushions and kitchen objects; same full postcode, coordinates, rent, bedrooms and description apart from a disclaimer. Two distinct Rightmove listing IDs for the same advertised home.

Wilmot GBP1850: same window and curtain pattern, projecting wall beside the kitchen opening, circular wire mirror, framed horizontal mirror, wall art, lamps, white cabinet and rug. R13/O08 show the same black-tiled kitchen and cabinet layout from different angles and both describe the second floor. O09 shows the same living room from closer viewpoints. Portable heater, furniture positions, lighting and floor appearance vary; the combined architectural and distinctive-object evidence supports one advertised home. No reliance on one decorative item alone.

Cheshire: R06 has two shuttered sash windows, central chimney/storage and a compact irregular plan; O16 has a broad double balcony door, recessed ceiling lights and a different modern open-plan kitchen. Distinct physical layouts.

Millennium Place: third floor, 37.53 square metres and different room arrangement versus second floor, approximately 44.2 square metres with skylit kitchen. Shared building/postcode is not shared dwelling.

Hackney Road: pink-sofa reception with arched windows and cream kitchen versus unfurnished split-level flat with rectangular sash windows and wooden kitchen. Separate floor configurations and locations.

Bradstock: San House single-level one-bedroom flat with modern cream kitchen versus Granard House seventh-floor two-bedroom maisonette with timber-panelled kitchen ceiling and internal staircase. This comparison crosses the bedroom block.
